title: BehavioralGateVerdict v1
description: CI merge-gate verdict produced by the behavioral contract extraction and structured diffing pipeline (KGR-G-011). Captures contract changes, scope classification, and the gate decision.

verdict_id.description: Unique identifier for this gate run.

commit_sha.description: Full Git commit SHA being evaluated.

base_sha.description: Base commit SHA for diff comparison.

decision.description: Gate outcome. ABSTAIN means the gate could not make a confident determination.

abstain_reason.description: Explanation when decision is ABSTAIN (e.g., AST parse failure, scope ambiguity).

contracts_analyzed.description: Total function/class contracts extracted and compared.

severity.description: Impact severity of the breaking change.

scope_classification.description: Abstraction scope where the break occurs.

files_analyzed.description: Source files included in the analysis.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time for the gate evaluation.
